rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for describing an action, claim, or situation as absurdly unreasonable.

example.english: They claimed, ludicrously, that they could earn hundreds of thousands a day.
example.traditional: 佢離譜咁話自己一日可以賺幾十萬。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lei4 pou2 gam3 waa6 zi6 gei2 jat1 jat6 ho2 ji5 zaan6 gei2 sap6 maan6

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal or written contexts when the manner is explicitly described as absurd.

example.english: The report ludicrously claimed that the project could be completed within a month.
example.traditional: 報告荒謬地聲稱，工程可以喺一個月內完成。
example.jyutping: bou3 gou3 fong1 mau6 dei6 sing1 cing1 gung1 cing4 ho2 ji5 hai2 jat1 go3 jyut6 noi6 jyun4 sing4
